hero.title: Run Propensity Score Matching Without Code
hero.description: ClinicalPSM is a propensity score matching tool for medical and academic researchers. It is currently under privacy and independent statistical review, and new analyses are temporarily paused.

upload.title: Upload Your Data
upload.description: CSV upload is paused during a privacy review. Our planned design processes datasets locally in your browser; that design is not yet in place.

configure.title: Configure & Match
configure.description: Select your treatment variable, outcome, and covariates. Set matching ratio (1:1, 1:2, 1:3) and an optional caliper. Nearest-neighbor matching only.

download.title: Download Results
download.description: Outputs include a standardized mean difference balance table, a Love plot, and a matched dataset CSV. These outputs have not completed independent statistical validation; verify them before any publication use.

login.title: Sign in
login.description: Enter your email and password to access your analyses.

register.title: Create account
register.description: Start with 1 free analysis daily — no credit card required.
register.passwordHint: At least 10 characters with one uppercase, one lowercase, and one special character.
register.emailHint: Use your institutional (.edu / .edu.tr) email — we're built for academic researchers.

validation.passwordTooShort: Password must be at least 10 characters
